claims.text: Coccidioidomycosis: azoles (eg, fluconazole) recommended for fibrocavitary dz.
claims.quote: Treatment with azoles, such as fluconazole, is recommended for patients with fibrocavitary disease.

claims.text: Histoplasmosis: most mild-mod acute pulm cases ⍉need tx;
claims.quote: Most individuals with mild or moderate acute pulmonary histoplasmosis do not require treatment.

claims.text: consider tx if immunocompromised or Sx ⍉improved after 4 wks;
claims.quote: Treatment should be considered in immunocompromised individuals and individuals whose symptoms have not improved after 4 weeks
